P.name: Umbra Blades
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Nocturne''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to slash in a circle, dealing {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies and {{tip|healing}} himself for {{pp|13 + (30-13)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} per enemy hit. Against {{tip|minions}}, ''Umbra Blades' '' damage to secondary targets and healing are reduced by 50% and it applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to all targets{{bug|2}} at 100% effectiveness.
P.description2: ''Umbra Blades'' can {{tip|critically strike}} against the primary target, modifying the {{as|physical damage}} dealt to{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nocturne|crit_base}}|100|mod=1.1}} AD.|AD}}|{{as|110% AD}}{{times}}{{sti|{{as|'''total''' critical damage}}}}.}}
P.description3: Basic attacks reduce ''Umbra Blades' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 3 against enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Duskbringer
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' casts out a shadow blade in the target direction that leaves a ''Dusk Trail'' in its wake, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit will leave a ''Dusk Trail'' behind while moving. ''Dusk Trails'' last 5 seconds and will slowly disappear afterwards.
Q.description2: While on the ''Dusk Trail'', '''Nocturne''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}}}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|15 to 55}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}

W.name: Shroud of Darkness
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' gains a {{tip|spell shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, ''Shroud of Darkness' ''{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} is doubled for 5 seconds.

E.name: Unspeakable Horror
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Nocturne''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|90% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby {{tip|fear|feared}} targets.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' torments the target, forming a {{tip|tether}} between himself and the target for 2 seconds, during which the target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration.
E.leveling2: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|80/4 to 260/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100/4}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is {{tip|fear|feared}} for a duration while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90%.

R.name: Paranoia
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' terrorizes all enemy champions, {{tip|nearsight|nearsighting}} them for 6 seconds, during which their {{tip|sight}} radius is reduced by {{tt|300 units|Total sight radius of enemy champions after reduction is 1050 units.}}. He can recast ''Paranoia'' for the same duration after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nocturne''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|physical damage}} upon arrival.
R.description3: '''''Nocturne''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] and [[Active_ability_items|item actives]] during the dash.''
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|140 to 90}}|Starts after recast times out or is used}}
